name: Mono Changelog
tagline: Black on white, Plex type, one release note at a time.
description: Calm, precise black-on-white look: IBM Plex Sans and Mono, thin grey rules, a strict left column, and rows that fade up one at a time, ending on a blinking caret. The preview is a release changelog with a version tag and numbered items.

mono.usage: Version tag, dates, kinds and issue numbers 24–30px

textAnimations: rule lines fading in with their item

rhythm.notes: Give each item half a second alone before the next one appears.

guide:
- Look only: build the user's own subject in this visual language; don't reuse the example's scene.
- Only black, white and two greys (#737373, #e5e5e5). No colour accents, no shadows, no rounded shapes except one 8px outlined tag.
- Typography does the work: IBM Plex Sans for statements and titles, IBM Plex Mono for labels, dates and numbers, generous white space, a strict left-aligned column.
- Structure everything as a calm list: small outlined mono tag → plain title → mono meta line → items separated by 2px #e5e5e5 rules, each with an uppercase mono label on the left, a short sentence, and a mono number or detail right-aligned.
- Show the subject through these rows and, if needed, simple black line drawings or plain photos in hard rectangular frames, never decorative illustration.
- Items fade up (y 30, 0.5s power2.out) 0.55s apart, with their rule fading in alongside. At most 4 items per scene.
- Cuts are plain fades or a hard cut to a final card: one short imperative line with a blinking block caret and a grey mono URL.
- Avoid colour, gradients, icons, motion flourishes and anything louder than black on white.
example: The preview is a product changelog: a version tag, a title, and NEW / FIXED / IMPROVED items with issue numbers, ending on a caret call to action. Don't copy this scene unless asked.
